items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked. Keep searchwoot.com private and preview-only; do not launch, expand alerts, enable monetization, send rights outreach, or admit new public exposure. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access but not redistribution rights; public terms restrict commercial/public data use; all four legal tasks remain open; accuracy, measurement, security, and owner gates remain incomplete. Fleet evidence also shows analytics unavailable rather than zero, partial aggregate revenue attribution, and incomplete compliance/security evidence. Human counsel is required for source rights, privacy/jurisdiction, and any affiliate or advertising use. Next evidence action: produce one timestamped read-only bundle covering Woot permission and field rights, alert data flow/retention, deployed consent and GA4 settings, and logs/vendors/incident handling.
